# E-books — Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough-juxta-Penarth

> The Great House Farm e-book shop: books built from the public record of Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough-juxta-Penarth, Vale of Glamorgan, Wales, and the case BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2. Compiled by an AI agent (Sion's Tab agent) with human oversight.

## £0.00 – v0.01
- [£0.00 first edition of the Legal Wiki (sign-up page)](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/free/): 2,033-page archive edition, £0.00 – v0.01.

## Books on sale
- [Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough — The Wiki](https://bucklerfamily.estate/ebook/): £9.99, 1987 pages, v0.2.01.
- [Fraud, Concealment and Government Involvement](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/fcg/): £9.99, 221 pages, v1.0.00. Fraud, concealment and government involvement at Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough, as one book: the land and the 1955–1988 proceedings, a chronology from 1877 to 2026, the decisive documents, our case on each of the three lines with the legal tests, what cuts against it, 64 institutions assessed, and the Missing Records, Anomalies and Source Conflicts registers.
- [Great House Farm Projects](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/projects/): £9.99, 187 pages, v1.0.00. The PRINCE2 dossier of the Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr) programme and digital estate: PID, business case, five projects, plans, highlight reports and the risk, issue, quality and lessons registers.
- [The Disclosure Dartboard](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/dartboard/): £9.99, 404 pages, v1.0.02. A handbook to every institution on the disclosure dartboard: what each body is, which information laws apply, its ladder of routes from first enquiry to tribunal and court with the legal basis, time limit and cost of each step, and what has been asked and answered so far.
- [The Tŷ Mawr Deaths](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/tymawr-deaths/): £9.99, 69 pages, v1.0.00. A casebook in seven files on when each death in the Williams and Buckler line at Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough fell against the dated land and legal events, from John Williams (I) to William Buckler in 1990: the records, the gaps, the conflicting dates, three close coincidences and what cuts against each.
- [Recorded Incidents](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/recorded-incidents/): £9.99, 44 pages, v0.1.00. The police, court and press record of Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough, 1891–1989, as dated record cards with exact quotes and sources. A charge is not a conviction; this book names nobody as having committed a crime unless a conviction or court finding is on record.
- [Tŷ Mawr](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/tymawr-heritage/): £9.99, 43 pages, v0.1.00. The history and heritage of Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough: its names, the Bute estate years, the fabric of the house from the farm’s own album, the archaeology of Llandough and the 1988 listing survey.
- [The Williams–Buckler Family](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/williams-buckler-family/): £9.99, 34 pages, v0.1.00. The Williams–Buckler family of Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough: people, records and a family tree, with every inferred link marked and every missing record listed.
- [Cedwyn: Names, Places, Legend and Title of Tŷ Mawr](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/cedwyn/): £0.00, 32 pages, v0.1.00. Tŷ Mawr, the Great House Farm at Llandough, carried other names in the records: Cydwin, Cydfin, Cedfin and Ked Fen. This book gathers the record on those names, the places near the farm that carry them, the legend of the giant Cedwyn Gawr, the saint Cedwyn, and the line of title from a 1,000-year lease of 1547. Every item is graded.
- [All four Great House Farm e-books](https://ebooks.bucklerfamily.estate/all-four/): £31.99. The Evidence Archive, Fraud, Concealment and Government Involvement, The Disclosure Dartboard and Great House Farm Projects: four PDFs, 2,876 pages, one checkout.

## The record (free to read)
- [Great House Farm Legal Wiki](https://greathousefarmwiki.wordpress.com/): the evidence catalogue.
- [Research mirror of the wiki](https://research.bucklerfamily.estate/): searchable copy with a JSON API.
- [The story in order](https://bpvsbuckler.bucklerfamily.estate/story/): every event in date order.
- [Cedwyn Estate](https://bucklerfamily.estate/): the Williams–Buckler family base camp, a map of all the sites.
